name: add-filter-menu
title: Add Filter Menu
description: + Filter: one input (“Filter by…”) that narrows the field list and, when the page passes an AI filter and the text reads as a phrase, offers “Filter with AI” first; fields drill into their value pickers in the same popover.

meta.whenToUse: Adding a filter to a FilterRow — by field or, with the page's AI filter, in plain language.
meta.whenNotToUse: Choosing a value for one known field (a facet), or a free-text search (SearchInput).
